notes.title: This Is the Comeback
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37274020/b5136843b3e017c7a00c1cdfa3695300768d1765.png[/img]

I’m back.

After years away from visual novel dev, I’ve launched a new Kickstarter to fund my return—starting with a brand-new game: [b]Mystic Destinies: Rebirth – Gales of Hikaru[/b].

The campaign ends soon, and I could really use your help in making it succeed: [url=http://kck.st/44s6WOj]http://kck.st/44s6WOj[/url]

But this isn’t just about a new game. I need your help to come back and continue my projects, too.

It’s about coming back to everything—[i]including TTEOTS.[/i]

Backers at the TTEOTS tier will get:
[list]
[*] [b]Early access to the serialized TTEOTS novel[/b]
[*] [b]Vote-based influence on what scenes/characters get expanded[/b]
[*] [b]Exclusive short stories and dev updates[/b]
[*] [b]Special thanks credit[/b]
[*] And access to the new Rebirth demo + live classes
[/list]
This is a chance to help fund not just a new project, but my return to all the stories I’ve started and still want to finish.

Whether you’ve been here from the start or you just discovered this world—thank you for believing in me.

— Aja

I still want to finish what we started. And I hope you’ll still be part of it.
